lines.text: Jesus asks how the Christ can be the Son of David when David calls Him Lord.
Jesus tells His disciples to beware of the scribes, who like to walk around in long robes.
Jesus says the scribes love the chief seats in the synagogues and defraud widows of their fields.
Jesus sees the rich putting gifts into the treasury, and a poor widow puts in two small silver coins.
Jesus says the poor widow has put in more than all the others, because she gave all she had.
